description_en: Sets the role of a user
kebab_example: aliyun yike set-yike-user-role --yike-user-id id --role-name Admin --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetYikeUserRole

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RAM user
parameters.name: yike_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The user role. Valid values:
- SuperAdmin: super administrator.
- Admin: administrator.
- RegularUser: regular member
parameters.help_zh:

- SuperAdmin：主管理员。
- Admin：管理员。
- RegularUser：普通成员
parameters.name: role_name
